orv.bubble.title: Need more guidance?
orv.hero.title: You are not alone after a traffic accident
orv.hero.p1: A traffic accident can cause uncertainty, pain and many questions. In those moments, having clear and timely guidance is essential.
orv.hero.p2: The Ministry of Transport and Communications offers you a free comprehensive guidance service for victims and their families, with the aim of providing information, accompaniment and guidance on the steps to follow, your rights and the available care channels.
orv.hero.p3: We are here to help you make informed decisions and accompany you at every stage of the process.

orv.servicios.title: Guidance Service for Victims of Traffic Accidents
orv.servicios.lead: We provide specialized guidance and support to people affected by a traffic accident, through a multidisciplinary and multisectoral approach that seeks to address the different needs that may arise after a road event.
orv.servicios.1.title: Insurance guidance
orv.servicios.1.desc: We help you understand the SOAT and CAT coverage so you know your rights and how to access the care and compensation you are entitled to.
orv.servicios.2.title: Psychological support
orv.servicios.2.desc: We provide professional accompaniment to victims of traffic accidents and their families, to help them cope with this difficult time and promote their well-being.
orv.servicios.3.title: Access to health services
orv.servicios.3.desc: We guide you on how to access medical care, treatments and rehabilitation processes you may need after an accident.
orv.servicios.4.title: Legal guidance
orv.servicios.4.desc: We provide clear information about legal procedures and your rights, so you can make informed decisions after a traffic accident.
orv.guia.title: Voluntary Registry of Traffic Accident Victims
orv.guia.subtitle: How to register your case
orv.guia.lead: Follow these steps to access the Voluntary Registry of Traffic Accident Victims.
orv.guia.1.title: File the report
orv.guia.1.desc: Go to the nearest police station to report the traffic accident. This step is important to record the event and start the corresponding processes.
orv.guia.2.title: Register your data
orv.guia.2.desc: Complete your information in our voluntary registration system so we can provide the guidance and support you need.
orv.guia.3.title: Follow-up of your case
orv.guia.3.desc: Check the status of your request and receive information about the progress of the guidance we are providing.
orv.registro.title: Voluntary Registry of Traffic Accident Victims
orv.registro.lead: Access our web platform to securely register your data and receive guidance. You will also be able to check the status of your request and track your case from anywhere.
orv.fondo.title: What is the SOAT and CAT Compensation Fund?
orv.fondo.lead: It is a mechanism that provides coverage to victims of traffic accidents when the responsible vehicle fled and could not be identified.
orv.fondo.q1: When can I access this fund?
orv.fondo.a1: You can access the SOAT and CAT Compensation Fund in hit-and-run cases, that is, when a traffic accident occurs and the responsible vehicle has not been identified.
orv.fondo.a2: To access this benefit you must complete the corresponding application and submit the required documents, such as the police report and medical expense receipts, through the official portal.
